verdict.rationale: Shopify serves agent-readable markdown versions of its developer docs (e.g. /docs/agents.md, /docs/apps/build/ai-toolkit.md, the cart, checkout and order MCP .md pages). Its AI Toolkit explicitly connects AI coding tools to Shopify's developer docs and API schemas, which satisfies the 'agent-oriented docs' branch of the story. However, the probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at shopify.dev/llms.txt), so there is no standard index file to point an agent at. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, an explicit doc describing the markdown-docs convention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
